description.summary: Swallowing the target in arcane magic, purple hexagon-like shields appear across the creature, shattering into pieces.
description.value: Swallowing the target in arcane magic, purple hexagon-like shields appear across the creature, shattering into pieces. The targeted creature has its reflect status effect removed. If the target fails their Will saving throw they cannot benefit from reflect for 1 round per 4 caster levels. This spell pierces the effects of reflect . This spell counters the reflect spell. This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for April 2021 by DeadKingKicker.
